translations.web: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
translations.bsb: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
translations.kjv: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
translations.asv: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.
